listing.name: Jet Set Radio Future (PAL) — JSRF-PAL-Recomp (yacineolivier-maker)
listing.summary: Upstream PAL-specific work-in-progress claims logos, graffiti warning, title/attract demo, new-game scenes/dialogue and first steps in-game at60FPS1080p with music, voices and sound effects. Saves and every stage remain untested upstream; no full campaign/completion claim. Current graphics text adds175% default supersampling/box filtering, lens ghosts/halo, light shafts and brighter additive particles. Do not inherit USA-port tests; Portcove has not verified any runtime/gameplay claim. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Europe title49470018 XDK4134 default.xbe SHA1 edd8547185025834df914724069aa1e63109cbc1 plus Media

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: README advertises JSRF.zip on Releases. Extract, put the owned Europe PAL ISO in assets (or its default.xbe plus Media folder), then run JSRF.exe. First start locally translates/compiles the game code from that copy; later starts reuse it and original game files remain necessary. Source build uses VisualStudio2022 C++/Clang/CMake and build.bat; release.bat produces a zip without original game code according to upstream. No release ZIP was downloaded/inspected.
